text_block_list.text:
To prepare for the Senior Year challenges 
ahead, I went for the New Year's shrine 
visit with Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey. Let's write those, you know, the 
things where you hang up your wishes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Writing down your wish is important too, 
you know. You wouldn't want to get into a 
"he said, she said" with the gods, right?

Prompted by Nice Nature, the wish I wrote 
down was...
choice_data_list: May Nice Nature get even stronger.
May Nice Nature learn more special skills.

text_block_list.text:
At all times, your body is your greatest 
asset. I made a wish that I'll be able to 
run safely through this entire year 
without incident.

To make her dream come true, she needs to 
become even stronger. I put my heart into 
wishing she could achieve the future she 
desires.

Nice Nature has become capable of so many 
things now. I made a wish for her to make 
even greater leaps forward in the future.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you sure took your sweet time 
writing that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah~. I guess it's that age where 
all sorts of worries start piling up, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Things like "May my back pain get better~" 
or "May I sleep more deeply~", right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then... wanting a pay raise~, or wanting a 
detached house~, and so on?
choice_data_list: I asked them to look after you
I asked them to look after you

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, about me? Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, even on New Year's... You really 
don't need to wish for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, you've got your own life to live 
too, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Right now, your success matters most!

Right now, your success is what matters 
most!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: N-Number one? Me............?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, there you go again, acting so 
carefree. You have no idea how I feel...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm, playing an active part, yeah, right! 
Sounds pretty heavy, but I gotta give it 
my all!
choice_data_list: We've got big goals ahead, too.
We've got big goals ahead, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...! This year's Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's truly heavy, but... I have 
to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I'll have to pay a visit to the Mejiro 
family at some point.

I recall what Nice Nature was talking 
about with the two members of the Mejiro 
family after the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you something far more 
certain than mere words. I am sure that 
will be more than enough for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because what those two call 'something 
certain' might just be the clue to getting 
stronger.
